It's nice thus far to see so many posting in this subverse. I enjoy reading all your stories and laughing at your misery. While I may look like I'm not around commenting, I log on daily to keep an eye on things.

However, I've been having an issue. I will be banning anyone for fat sympathy (or more, sympathy against the antagonist in the story, who must be fat), but I wonder if I should be banning people for being fat altogether?

I do enjoy FPH quite a bit, but here, I want this subverse to be more accessible, more interesting and encouraging of more stories. So, I see a couple of options...

  • Banning all fat people outright

  • A 'don't ask, don't tell' policy on your own weight, but admission of being fat will result in a ban

  • Allowing people of all body types to post openly, provided the stories are decent

Before making any rule changes, I want to see what people think. While I'm the mod, this place is nothing without you lot, and I'm more than happy to discuss any potential changes openly.

Personally, I think a "don't ask, don't tell" policy would suit everybody. It stops humble bragging about being ripped, and keeps posts straight to the story, while also allowing anyone to post. But I won't be making any changes until a decent discussion has been had.

It seems people get confused when thinking about what "witchhunting" actually is.

If someone does something that many people disagree with, then there will be uproar. When people protest about that someone's actions, people seem to think that's true witchhunting, but it's not really.

Witchhunting usually involves the needless/immoral/over-exaggerated attack of a person, where the attack is disproportional to the bad actions of the someone.

But when someone does something really bad, and people are not happy, that's not a witchhunt. That's simply many people disagreeing with you. It's usually a sign that you're wrong, or being an idiot.

People love to misuse words to defend themselves against unhappy masses.
